Messages.Author: LunaSlave
Messages.Body:
Name: Tyrone, the Weekender
Cardtype: Vampire
Clan: Ventrue
Level: Basic
Group: 6
Capacity: 6
Discipline: pot dom PRE FOR
Camarilla. During your untap phase, if Tyrone is ready, he may burn 1 blood to become Anarch (and Independent) until the end of the turn. He may not become a Baron.

Art notes: Tyrone's age at the time of embrace appears to be his late 30's. He is black, has a shaved head, and is immaculately dressed in an expensive 3 piece business suit. Behind him is his wardrobe, in which hang an array of well-pressed dress clothes - and an out-of-place looking leather jacket bearing numerous gutter punk patches, pins and spikes.

World of Darkness reference: Vampire: The Masquerade Guide to the Camarilla (WW 2302) page 207.

How does this address a compelling game need?: Tyrone would potentially allow players to dabble with an anarch strategy without committing to it fully either by playing other cards to make him anarch or having to take the standard, yet expensive action that costs 2 blood. This could create more possible decktypes and slightly greater flexibility with that mechanic. Tyrone's ability may also help to mitigate the bad draws that so often seem to come with anarch decks when they can't get easy access to Anarch Converts or other cards to "go anarch". Besides, the last big group of anarchs was Group 4 - we're due for some more!

Created by: Jay Gannon

Messages.Author: Ohlmann
